description: This file defines the SupportAppClient class, which extends the AwsClient class and provides methods to interact with the AWS Support App service API. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, and listing Slack channel configurations, as well as registering Slack workspaces.

classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Support App service, extending the base AwsClient.
